verdict.rationale: The office publishes some delegation material of its own. It has registered-agent appointment and change forms, a defined Commercial Registered Agent role for agents representing more than 10 companies, and an 'Authorized Users' designation for UCC e-filing. Nothing in the evidence spells out what a third party may or may not file on an entity's behalf, or which signatures must stay personal. Missing for 10: a published scope of what agents/filers may and may not do, rules on which signatures must be personal, a documented role/permission model for WyoBiz account delegation, independent corroboration.
